decisive_items: soft tissue calcifications unrelated to bone or cartilage
calcified tissue with inflamed stroma and necrosis
response.rationale: Imaging and pathology directly demonstrate soft-tissue calcification with inflammation and necrosis, and the skin findings support cutaneous/subcutaneous involvement, making calcinosis cutis more specific than generic calcinosis and better supported than scleroderma alone.
